objective: Validate a fixed shortlist from Generation 011 without reselecting strategies, horizons, states, or transition phases and without constructing a router.
baseline_evidence_source: Generation 011 baseline cohort; no redundant rerun.
gates: at least 20 events, five state episodes, and three calendar years
episode-cluster bootstrap 95% lower bound above zero
Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-value at or below 0.05 within period
positive mean in at least 60% of represented years
positive after an additional conservative 20-basis-point round-trip stress
limitations: All dates through 2026-09-03 were visible before this declaration, so results remain retrospective.
Stable and pending-transition entries are separate hypotheses.
Passing is evidence for forward-shadow testing, not capital routing or promotion.
